_about: Template for a region pack. `onboard.py scaffold-region <code> "<Country>"` copies this folder to profile/regions/<code>/ and rules/regions.md says how to research each field. Delete every _comment key when done. Patterns are plain letters (fold umlauts and accents: ae oe ue ss, e for accented e) matched against the folded text of the full posting.
name: Country name

country_hints._comment: ISO code -> regex of city and region words that identify it in a location string, for places resources/countries.json does not know

route_rules._comment: First rule whose `when` holds wins. when keys: authorization (list of profile statuses), country, not_country (ISO lists; __home__ = home market), kind (list), stage, employer_re, url_re, source_re, text_re, not_text_re, any (list of alternative conditions), needs_authorization (bool). adj is added to the content score (0..10 after clamping).
route_rules.note: What the law lets a student do here, with the article or rule it comes from

route_default.note: No route rule matched: the host country's own permit rules apply

walls._comment: A wall is something the posting demands that the applicant cannot meet. label shows in the verdict; re is matched on the folded full text; unless_re cancels a hit; when limits it; route_block true means 'no legal route'.
walls.label: Security clearance

boards.name: Name of a job board
boards.note: What it is good for, whether a plain fetch works, how its alerts arrive
